title: Baja-Insights live stream message (contract v1.1)
description: One message of the WebSocket between the stream service (Azure Container Apps) and the UI. New in v1.1. The order inside an 'overlay' message is validated separately with overlay.schema.json.

subscribe.description: UI to server, on connect and on every reconnect. from_t_s is the last match second the UI already has; the server answers with a 'state' and replays every order still on screen at from_t_s or after it (show_at_s + duration_s > from_t_s), so a graphic that was showing when the connection dropped comes back.

overlay.description: Server to UI. A graphics order. The server sends every variant; the UI filters by mode and language.

clock.description: Server to UI, once per second of wall time. It is the heartbeat: three seconds without one means the UI shows 'reconnecting'.

speed.description: Replay speed, 1 for real time, 60 for the demo

state.description: Server to UI, after 'subscribe' and after every goal, half time and full time. The scoreline comes from the events, the UI never works it out.

error.description: Server to UI. The UI keeps the last confirmed data on screen and shows the message.
